Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In the initial search for "James Fieser Bates College" (Step 1), the WebSurfer correctly identified that James Fieser received his B.A. from Bates College based on the Wikipedia snippet. However, in Step 4, when searching for "James Fieser Bates College biography", the WebSurfer hallucinated or misread the search results, claiming that "James Fieser is an American philosopher... He received his B.A. from Berea College." This directly contradicts the verified information found in the same conversation history (Step 1 and Step 2) and external reality (James Fieser's B.A. is indeed from Bates College). This error introduced a false candidate (Berea College) and created unnecessary confusion, leading the Planner to waste subsequent steps trying to resolve a conflict that did not exist.
